DD_Attribute.name: body_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Classification of the celestial body being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: A planetary body orbiting a star
A natural satellite orbiting a planet
A small rocky body orbiting the sun
An icy small solar system body
A planet outside our solar system
Any body type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: object_name
DD_Attribute.definition: Specific name of the celestial body being studied.

DD_Attribute.name: parent_body
DD_Attribute.definition: For moons/satellites, specifies the parent planet or body.

DD_Attribute.name: primary_field
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary scientific field of study.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Study of planetary surfaces and geological processes
Physical properties and processes of planetary bodies
Study of planetary atmospheres
Study of life in the universe
Study of celestial objects and phenomena
Study of motion and forces in planetary systems
Laboratory-based analysis and experiments
Study of planetary magnetic fields and their interactions
Physics of space environments
Any field not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: investigation_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Method of scientific investigation used.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Collection of data from a distance
Direct analysis of physical samples
Computer-based simulation or modeling
Direct observation of phenomena
Any investigation type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: collection_method
DD_Attribute.definition: Method used to collect the data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Data collected by an orbiting spacecraft
Data collected by a surface lander
Data collected by a mobile surface rover
Data collected by Earth-based or space telescopes
Analysis of returned physical samples
Data collected in laboratory settings
Any collection method not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: instrument_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of instrument used to collect the data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Instrument that measures spectra
Imaging device
Radio detection and ranging instrument
Light detection and ranging instrument
Instrument that measures ground motion
Instrument that measures magnetic fields
Any instrument type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: data_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Format or type of the collected data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Visual representation data
Spectral measurement data
Sequential data collected over time
Spatial representation data
Results from computational models
Any data type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: material_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Physical type of material being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Solid mineral material
Frozen water or other volatiles
Gaseous material
Fine particulate material
Surface layer of loose material
Liquid state material
Any material type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: feature_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of geological or physical feature being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Impact depression on a surface
Elevated landform
Elongated depression
Dark plains on the Moon
Volcanic landform
Atmospheric cloud formation
Any feature type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: process_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of process being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Collision processes
Volcanic activity
Crustal deformation processes
Atmospheric processes
Surface degradation processes
Any process type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: size_category
DD_Attribute.definition: Size classification of the celestial body.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Asteroids, comets, and other small solar system bodies
Rocky planets with solid surfaces like Earth, Mars
Large planets composed mainly of hydrogen and helium
Planets composed mainly of ices, like Uranus and Neptune
Celestial bodies that orbit the Sun and have sufficient mass for gravity to make them round
Any size category not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: location
DD_Attribute.definition: Location of the celestial body within the cosmos.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Within the asteroid belt (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars)
Beyond the asteroid belt (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune)
The region beyond Neptune's orbit
The distant shell of icy objects surrounding the solar system
Outside our solar system
Any location not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: study_focus
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary focus area of the scientific study.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Study focused on surface features or properties
Study focused on internal structure or processes
Study focused on atmospheric properties or dynamics
Study focused on magnetic field properties or interactions
Study focused on orbital properties or behaviors
Study focused on chemical or mineral composition
Any focus not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: resolution_scale
DD_Attribute.definition: Spatial scale or resolution of the collected data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Data covering an entire celestial body
Data covering a significant region of a celestial body
Data covering a small, localized area
Data at microscopic scale
Any resolution scale not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: temporal_coverage
DD_Attribute.definition: Temporal span or coverage of the collected data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Data from past events or periods
Contemporary or recent data
Data collected over an extended time period
Data from a single, discrete event
Any temporal coverage not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: composition
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary composition of the material being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Composed primarily of silicate minerals
Composed primarily of metallic elements
Composed primarily of organic compounds
Composed primarily of water or other volatile ices
Composed primarily of gas
Composed of a mixture of different materials
Any composition not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: mission_name
DD_Attribute.definition: Name of the mission associated with the data.

DD_Attribute.name: mission_phase
DD_Attribute.definition: Phase of the mission during which the data was collected.

DD_Attribute.name: funding_source
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary source of funding for the mission or research.

DD_Attribute.name: collection_date
DD_Attribute.definition: Date or time period when the data was collected.

DD_Attribute.name: processing_level
DD_Attribute.definition: Level of processing applied to the raw data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Unprocessed data directly from the instrument
Data that has been calibrated but not further processed
Higher-level data product derived from processed data
Combined data from multiple observations or sources
Any processing level not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: temperature_regime
DD_Attribute.definition: Temperature conditions at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Extremely low temperatures, typically below 120K
Below freezing but not extreme
Moderate temperatures, similar to Earth temperate regions
High temperatures but below extreme
Very high temperatures like Venus surface
Wide temperature variations or cycles
Any temperature regime not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: pressure_conditions
DD_Attribute.definition: Pressure conditions at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Essentially no atmospheric pressure
Minimal atmospheric pressure like Mars
Similar to Earth's atmospheric pressure
Higher than Earth's atmospheric pressure
Very high pressure like Venus surface or gas giant interiors
Significant pressure variations or gradients
Any pressure condition not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: radiation_environment
DD_Attribute.definition: Radiation conditions at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Minimal radiation exposure like Earth surface
Similar to Earth orbit or Mars surface
Significant radiation like Jupiter radiation belts
Very high radiation levels
Protected or shielded from external radiation
Any radiation environment not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: atmospheric_presence
DD_Attribute.definition: Presence and nature of atmosphere at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: No significant atmosphere
Minimal atmosphere like Mercury or Moon
Tenuous atmosphere like Mars
Similar to Earth's atmosphere
Dense atmosphere like Venus or Titan
Massive, deep atmosphere of a gas giant
Any atmospheric presence not covered by other values

DD_Class.definition: Information about the scientific discipline and research context.

DD_Class.name: Data_Collection
DD_Class.definition: Information about how the data was collected and its format.

DD_Class.name: Physical_Properties
DD_Class.definition: Information about the physical properties of the object under study.

DD_Class.name: Mission_Context
DD_Class.definition: Information about the mission context of the data.

DD_Class.name: Environmental_Context
DD_Class.definition: Information about the environmental conditions at the study location.

DD_Class.name: Analysis_Properties
DD_Class.definition: Information about the analysis methods and properties of the data.

DD_Class.name: Research_Context
DD_Class.definition: Information about the research context and associated metadata.

DD_Class.name: Planetary_Data_Dictionary
DD_Class.definition: A comprehensive metadata dictionary for planetary science data.
